paragraphs.text: Shaper Tuvasa , also known as the Sunlit , was a Great Shaper of the River Heralds on Ixalan .

Unlike the other River Heralds, Tuvasa feels a strong affinity for Ixalan's sun , believing that the sun unites the wind, water, and jungle. She lost her life during the New Phyrexian Invasion and her name and position were inherited by her apprentice.
